spans.s:
कुण् {vI.v} {c6c} P. (कुणति, कुणित)
1 To
support, aid.
--2 To sound. {vII.v} {c10c} P. (
कणयति)
1 To counsel, advise.
--2 To
converse or speak with.
--3 To
invite.
--4 To salute.

कूण् {c10c} U. (कूणयति-ते, कूणित)
1
To speak, converse.
--2 To contract,
close (said to be Atm. in this
sense).
कुणकः A young animal just born.

; often
used as a term of contempt with
living beings.
--पः
1 A spear.
--2 A foul
smell, stench.

कुणारु a. Ved. Crying out, (
क्विणनशील);

1 A cripple with a withered
or crooked arm.
--2 A whitlow.
कूणि a. Having a crooked arm.

1 The horn of any
animal.
--2 The peg of a lute.
